description.text: Students who are major in this program mainly study the basic theories of math, physics, chemistry, mechanics, geology, engineering science, and foundamental knowledge of petroleum engineering related. The educational aim of Petroleum Engineering specialty is to cultivate qualified personnel with advanced technology and engineering knowledge. They don’t gain just the basic training on petroleum engineering, but also can be engaged in petroleum engineering design, operation and construction, production and management, scientific development about oil and gas drilling engineering, oil extraction, petroleum reservoir engineering, reservoir evaluation, etc. Main Courses: Technological Economics, Oil and Gas Development Geology, Engineering Mechanics, Computer Programming, Fluid Mechanics, Permeation Fluid Mechanics, Drilling Engineering, Oil Extraction, Petroleum Reservoir Engineering, Oilfield Chemistry, Drilling New Technology, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering

duration.text: The Petroleum Engineering at Yanshan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2180 USD/per year ￥ 15700 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) The copy of HSK level certificate (Level-6 is required by Liberal Arts majors and Level-4 is required by Sciences majors). 6.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.
